intro: A relaxing coloring-by-numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with different themes, levels of complexity, and sizes.
description:
The objective is quite simple: each level contains numerous uncolored pixels, and it is your job to color them in. Each pixel is numbered; this number corresponds to a color in your palette. Select a color from the palette and paint each corresponding pixel. Correctly color all pixels in a level to finish it!

Coloring Pixels is a great way to wind down; you can just sit back and relax. With 180 levels, you can have hours of fun. This collection contains 8 themed books:

Candy Book - Candies and sweet treats from around the world in one book, guaranteed to make your mouth water!

Fantasy Maps Book - Maps from mythology, fantasy and everything imaginary!

Pastels Book - Dive into Spring with this calming, cute, pastel book!

Zodiac Book - All 12 signs and various meanings are shown in this book!

Gothic Book - A look back in time to a beloved European culture!

Alchemy Book - Images portray chemistry, alchemy, and even a hint of magic!

Playing Cards Book - An image for each card in a standard deck of playing cards, in the New Deck Order!

Celebration XL Book - Revisit new levels based on some of your favourite books from the past, celebrating the best of Coloring Pixels so far!
